messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: value_of for vectors?
parts:
Hi!

I was wondering if there is a value_of function available for vectors of vars (or doubles). So, let's say I got

vector<var> myvec1;
vector<double> myvec2;

value_of_vec(myvecX) would return me myvec1/2 as a vector of doubles. I know that I could write a loop to do that, but this does not always work, i.e. when initializing a variable in a constructor.

I haven't found such a function in stan math, but maybe it is there?

Thanks!

Best,
Sebastian

messages.author: 89abf8a3796a510b
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] value_of for vectors?
parts:
Hi Sebastian,

Will this function do?

https://github.com/stan-dev/math/blob/develop/stan/math/prim/mat/fun/value_of.hpp

There's also:

https://github.com/stan-dev/math/blob/develop/stan/math/prim/mat/fun/value_of_rec.hpp

The difference between the two is that value_of_rec will always return a double no matter which of the following you apply value_of_rec to: var, fvar<var>, etc. 

value_of will return only one step down: value_of(var x) --> x->val_, a double, but value_of(fvar<var> x) --> x.val_ which is a var.

Rob


Rob
